caseName: World Airways, Inc. v. Pan American World Airways, Inc.
caseNameFull: World Airways, Inc. v. Pan American World Airways, Inc.
attorneys: Clayton L. Burwell and Frederick Bemays Wiener on the motion.

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. (Certiorari granted, ante, p. 919.) Motion to substitute Trans International Airways, Inc., a Delaware corporation, in place of Trans International Airways, Inc., a California corporation, as a party petitioner granted.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
